item.title: Farmer Says He’s Cleared Public-Financing Threshold
item.description: Justin Farmer announced on Wednesday that he has met the qualifications for the state’s public campaign finance program, having raised $7,590 from 238 donors in his bid to become the next state representative of the 92nd district. The post Farmer Says He’s Cleared Public-Financing Threshold appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Sabin Campaign Walks The Hill
item.description: At Sylvan Avenue's Superstar Market, customer Anthony Lowery had a suggestion for the state representative candidate vying for his vote: Let members of the community clean up blighted properties -- and get paid to do it. The post Sabin Campaign Walks The Hill appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Dillon Supporters Tout Deep Track Record
item.description: “Experience counts,” said DiDi Strode, summing up a sentiment heard again and again inside Westville’s Kehler Liddell Gallery on Wednesday evening. Strode was explaining her support for incumbent State Rep. Pat Dillon, who is running to continue representing the 92nd General Assembly District, having served for over four decades in the role. The post Dillon Supporters Tout Deep Track Record appeared first on New Haven Independent.
